name: jobs
description: Background jobs: start a long command without parking the turn, then list/wait/kill. Input: {"op":"start","argv":["zig","build"]} | {"op":"list"} | {"op":"wait","id":"job-..."} | {"op":"kill","id":"..."}. wait blocks until the process exits and returns {exit}. Subagent jobs from subagent {"background":true} use wait/list too.
llm_description: Start, list, wait, or kill a background job. {op:start, argv:[cmd,...]} returns an id. {op:list} shows exec and background-subagent jobs (done flag). {op:wait,id} blocks until that job exits and returns {exit}. {op:kill,id}. Use this for long builds instead of blocking exec.
